incident: Search CPU spike from unbounded query
symptoms: one query pattern dominated CPU profiles
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A newly enabled query allowed an expensive unbounded wildcard search.
successful_steps: Added CPU alert tied to query rate
resolution: An unbounded wildcard query saturated search CPU. Restricting the query and adding cost controls restored latency.
postmortem: Scaling delayed saturation but did not remove the expensive query.
CPU limit changes only postponed the problem.
